content: GRC platforms (Vanta, Drata, Cyber Sierra, Secureframe, Scrut) bridge failed controls/remediation tasks to Jira/ServiceNow via: (1) manual one-click 'Create Jira Issue' from a failing test/task, pre-populated with failure reason, related control, and remediation steps; (2) optional auto-create workflow rule (e.g. 'every time test X fails, create ticket') with dedup check against existing open issues; (3) fire-and-forget one-way push on create, but bidirectional close-loop sync on resolution — when the external ticket is closed/resolved, the GRC platform polls or webhooks back to mark the compliance task resolved and triggers re-verification, without requiring the user to log into the GRC tool. Full two-way field sync (status, comments, assignee) is a differentiator, not baseline.
